intent: Apply the MARCHAND specialization's 10% bonus to NPC-order coin rewards without changing rewards for other specializations.
rationale: The supplied ProgressionService.npcCoinReward method returns the base reward in both branches, so MARCHAND receives no specialization bonus. Changing only the MARCHAND branch to add 10% fixes the causal defect while leaving the non-MARCHAND branch unchanged and follows the supplied codebase's integer percentage-bonus convention.
public_checks: Confirmed NpcOrderService.completeOrder applies ProgressionService.npcCoinReward to the NPC coin reward before PlayerService.reward.
Confirmed the parent ProgressionService.java SHA-256 matches task-manifest parent_source_sha256.
Inspected supplied public tests: NpcOrderServiceTest verifies delegation to npcCoinReward and ProgressionServiceTest covers existing specialization behavior.
uncertainties: No supplied public test directly asserts the MARCHAND 10% arithmetic or a non-multiple-of-10 rounding case.
The public JUnit guard was not executed because the supplied bundle has no local Maven distribution and its wrapper would need an external download, which is outside the bundle-only boundary.
